assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/zenba-nana-manga.md (FXK-P020, version 1.0, 73,405 bytes, status canonical, empty supersession arrays, veto false), a self-contained portrait of Zenba Nana within the Japanese collected manga main narrative to V10 i0156 (Monday 24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's observation, decision, claim, forecast, checkpoint and open-item IDs, with brief Japanese quotations. She appears in V09 only as a silhouette identified by V10 (V09 i0110) and in person on V09 i0148-i0152, then in every V10 chapter, focal in 第48-50話 with a 2013 flashback. Her interior is reached through inner speech, a stretch of first-person narration (i0097-i0102), home scenes, her fan account and surveillance list and the voice she supplies for 綺羅メイ, which the portrait keeps apart from her office speech. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS and a fidelity PASS after revision. The V09 and V10 readings, the V10 checkpoint, the decision and evidence ledger, the reconciliation and qualification audits and Studies B and C that it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly. Neither the project's COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY outcome nor its statement that the section 12 profile confers no reconstruction grade was adopted as a grade. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: April 2017 in located states: 3 April (the welcome party, inferred date: reasoned public caution, private fear, savings 834,877円); 7 April (refuses Kizuna's daily invitation); 8 April (asks Yasuko to teach her stocks); by 21 April, date inferred from page order (account opened, 100,000円 deposited, first order rejected for its unit); 21 April (wishes Kizuna's loss, adopts her maxim, doubts concentration, pivots to the Kani Games proxy); 22 April (plan, reserve rule, order accepted); 24 April (500 Kani shares filled at 741円, −8,000円 by evening, fandom exposed at work, the plea to Kizuna, ending at V10 i0156). The change from abstainer to shareholder falls between 8 and 24 April and is split at those located states. Her fandom since 2010, her 2013 refusal, envy and witness of Yasuko's liquidation, her years without work and her hiring in about autumn 2015 are disclosed history that belongs to her at every state. Every outcome after V10 i0156 is outside scope.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Sections 3, 4 and 12 give an organizing account with located counterconditions: a public office self built deliberately on Mochiko's model after years without work (SR HIGH, i0087-i0088), an anxious, invested private self of fandom and surveillance (i0056-i0060, i0082-i0084), and money as the bridge between them in V10. The account says why her answer to investing changes: Kizuna's pressure draws refusal and resentment (i0062-i0064); Yasuko, whose 2013 ruin grounded the fear, separates cash stocks from FX and endorses buying in support, and the decision is assembled from trusted voices (i0090-i0096; EVAL HIGH, separation INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH); the purchase is reframed as a higher rank of fandom (i0101). It predicts her mistakes as well as her prudence: the unit error from hearsay (i0105), certainty from fan expertise (i0103), about 44% of her printed assets in one proxy despite her own concentration doubt (i0126-i0142), a resolve broken within two pages (i0151, i0153). Not A: one decision path over three weeks; rival readings (investing as recovery or as status; her rule as temperament or borrowed doctrine) diverge only outside the window, and the gag-form interior shows what she wants and fears, not how strongly she would act (section 13). Not C: the evidence discriminates her response by who asks, by framing and by instrument, and locates where it stops.

Section 11 dates a real transition: abstainer on 3 and 7 April, a request to Yasuko on 8 April, an account and a rejected order by 21 April (inferred), a plan and accepted order on 22 April and a filled position with a paper loss on 24 April; her relation to Kizuna moves from irritation at a recruiter to rivalry with fear of being outspent (21-24 April), and colleagues learn of her fandom and investing on 24 April. Late revelation (2010 fandom, 2013 witness, the years without work) is kept apart from change, and the persona, the watching habit and a low self-estimate are shown not to change. Not B: one transition across three weeks, with the 2013 and 2015 states known only from a flashback and a few lines, and nothing after 24 April. Not D: the states are dated, page-located and given a mechanism.

Section 6 distinguishes five registers with located instances: office です/ます with crisp nominal verdicts and hedged objections (i0007, i0038, i0064); a plain, petulant home register (i0056-i0057); plain, warm candour with Yasuko (i0087-i0096; 2013, i0066-i0079); public politeness online over a private fandom vocabulary and crude contempt, with a katakana-tinged menace under extreme provocation (i0082-i0084, i0153); and a literate, mock-epic first-person narration (i0097-i0102). 私 in every register; surname plus さん for every colleague, with 高根さん, やす子さん and やす子ちゃん tracking setting and guard; the cornering polite question, the lecture, hyperbole and the 発射 idiom; under exposure, stammer then over-disclosure or an appeal that keeps its formality and apology (i0145-i0156). Not A: three weeks of lettering, no performed voice, few lines with her mother and none addressed directly to Mochiko, and some attributions rest on placement. Not C: the rules are located per listener and setting and constrain illustrative written Japanese closely.

Sections 5 and 8 locate an office manner (morning greeting, short acknowledgements, scolding the office sleeper, a friendly question to the newcomer) and home habits (greeting 綺羅メイ on coming home, voicing him, checking fan posts and adding accounts to a list, quarrels with her mother), and separate stable preferences from situational choices. Not B: her creative work and her teaching of Inago are never shown, no food preference is stated, and her life outside home, work and fandom is unknown. Not D: several habits recur across scenes in two settings.

Section 7 gives directed, dated ties with stated directed differences: Yasuko across 2013, autumn 2015 and April 2017, guarded at work (V09 i0150) and candid and dependent in private (i0087-i0096); Kizuna, resented recruiter, then object of unspoken schadenfreude, then rival over 綺羅メイ, priced by money (i0041-i0156); Inago, protected and feared as a comparison (i0016, i0037, i0087, i0151); Kurumi, scolded, cornered and guarded (V09 i0151-i0152; i0042, i0064-i0065); Mochiko as task-giver and model (i0088); her mother in an open, childish quarrel (i0056-i0057); fellow fans welcomed in public and surveilled in private. The mechanisms (trust, persona protection, rivalry of money and fandom rank) explain why the same pressure or exposure draws different responses by person. Not A: each tie is sampled over three weeks, her mother in one scene and Mochiko without a direct exchange; no man, father, friend other than Yasuko or superior in conflict is shown. Not C: the differences across ties and settings are located and explained.

The portrait records an unusually full interior for a supporting figure: thought balloons and inner lines at work and home, first-person narration across 第49話 (i0097-i0102), her private fan account and 617-account surveillance list (i0082-i0084), the self-voiced 綺羅メイ who comforts and authorizes her (i0059-i0060, i0127, i0131), and inner content that differs from her speech in kind (certainty, contempt, wishes for a rival's loss, fear; i0103, i0125, i0155). That access reaches the motives of her central decision. Not A: three weeks; much of the interior is drawn as gag, which the portrait reads as disposition not severity; whether investing is recovery or status stays open. Not C: the access is direct, multi-channel and extensive.

Her conflict modes are located: courteous interrogation rather than outright statement (i0064, i0083, i0146), refusal of pressure (i0062), deflection and denial when cornered (i0042, i0145), open petulance with her mother (i0057), inner hostility toward Kizuna that is enjoyed but never acted on (i0122, i0125, i0140-i0141), and escalation to speech only when she fears losing 'her' character, still with formality and apology (i0155-i0156). Not B: open conflict is tested once with Kizuna, whose answer lies beyond V10, and once with her mother; there is no sustained escalation. Not D: several modes and a stated escalation condition are located.

Positions are implicit and located: an objection to Kizuna's trading during work that is moral in form and rivalrous in feeling (i0122, i0155); a disputed claim about her household contribution (i0042 against i0057, INFERENCE MODERATE that she overstated it, UNRESOLVED); a misunderstanding left uncorrected (i0154); a wish for a rival's loss that she briefly shakes off (i0125). Two self-corrections are shown, one broken within two pages (i0151, i0153). Not C: she weighs no consequential ethical choice. Not E: several stances and self-corrections are located with their contexts.

Her own humour is deadpan judgment (i0007) and friendly needling of Yasuko (2013, i0079), with play in the voice she gives 綺羅メイ (i0059, i0127, i0135); most comedy around her is at her own expense, in gag faces, the kneeling before an imagined mother (i0132) and the katakana menace (i0153). Not B: few instances of her own humour, and the portrait treats the gags as the page's staging. Not D: style and function are characterized across scenes.

One dedicated, independently reviewed portrait covers every appearance (the V09 silhouette identified by V10, V09 i0148-i0152, every V10 chapter and the 2013 flashback), routes material interpretations to page occurrences and accepted IDs (section 14), lists forty re-opened pages and keeps evidence layers apart (speech, thought, narration, others' views, placement-attributed lines, calculations). Not A: the row curates only this derived item; the readings, ledger, checkpoint and studies behind it are not on the row. Not C: within its boundary the portrait enumerates the evidence rather than sampling it.

Affirmative bounds are located against specific overreadings: Inago's i0044 thoughts are not hers (checkpoint C-01); the i0145-i0146 lines are Kurumi's; her 'only on a break' claim is only partly contradicted, since working hours are not printed (B-5, C-05); whether the +500 on the board is her order is a preserved disagreement; she did not borrow the 発射 idiom from Kizuna (D-5); her hostility to Kizuna never becomes action (i0125, i0140); she does not chase at −8,000円 (D-12); she declined to stake most of her savings (i0107); the forecast that she would be drawn at creative work is disconfirmed (F013); section 13 states what would overturn each central claim. Not A: the bounds sit within three weeks and no scoreable forecast about her market conduct is tested. Not C: the bounds carry IDs and page locators.

States carry calendar placement (3, 7, 8, 21, 22 and 24 April 2017; 5 and 14 November and 3 December 2013; summer 2010; about autumn 2015), with a dated money chain that closes exactly (reconciliation §4.10), and section 2 maps what she knows when, including what she does not know about Kurumi's debt. Not A: the 3 April date and the account opening are inferred, and the span of the present is three weeks. Not C: the dates are page-located and change is separated from disclosure (section 11).

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; the evidence is lettering, so no performed voice is claimed.
私 in every register; surname plus さん for every colleague (月森さん, 酒田さん, 福賀さん); 高根さん when guarding herself from Yasuko at work and やす子ちゃん in private; no direct address of Mochiko is printed.

Office: です/ます, short and crisp, nominal verdicts, objections hedged with 気がします or せめて, and courteous cornering questions. Home: plain and petulant (じゃん, もん, なの). With Yasuko: plain, warm and candid. Fandom, online and inner: fandom vocabulary, crude contempt and, only under extreme provocation, katakana-tinged menace.

Under exposure: stammer, then over-disclosure or an appeal that keeps formality and apology (i0145-i0156). Inner contempt and wishes for a rival's loss stay inner; they reached speech once, as a plea.

Interlocutors are the sampled Kizuna, Kurumi, Inago, Yasuko, her mother and Mochiko (acknowledgements only). A man, her father, a stranger face to face or a superior in conflict are unsampled; any such transfer is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the register rules.
No speech after a large loss, a profit, a sale, or Kizuna's answer to the plea.
scenario_readiness.note: Five located registers and their address and pressure rules constrain illustrative written Japanese with the sampled interlocutors closely enough for bounded use.

conditions: Pressed toward a risky money choice by an enthusiastic colleague she does not trust: predict polite refusal reasoned from amateurs and preparation, private resentment, and shielding a junior by putting work first (section 12, HIGH).

The same kind of choice endorsed by a trusted friend, or framed as support of what she loves: predict that the answer changes, with certainty about the thesis, research into the company behind it and eagerness to act; the fandom frame is observed once and is untested for other passions.

Sizing her own money: predict research, correct calculation, a reserve of about half kept in the bank, no leverage, refusal to stake most of her savings on one stock, and still a concentrated single position, with the imagined 綺羅メイ approving it. One instance; abstain on a second purchase.
A small paper loss: predict deflation, no selling or adding, continued watching and concealment of its extent. Abstain for a large loss, a profit or a decision to sell.
Caught in a gap between self-presentation and fact: predict a flinch, denial or deflection, then frequent over-disclosure, while the core secret (the stock's name, size and loss) is kept.

Her favourite misread or claimed by someone she ranks as shallow: predict silent contempt, inner menace and inward claims of priority and rank; speech only when she fears losing 'her' character, still formal and apologetic (once, i0156); a junior she respects may instead draw a self-correction (i0151).
A rival exposed to loss: predict the wish, a plan to watch, pleasure at a presumed loss and frustration at calm, with no action and nothing said to the rival.

Include her mistakes: acting on hearsay, reading fan expertise as market foresight, concentrating despite her own doubt, breaking a fresh resolve, and possibly overstating what she contributes at home.
A trusted confidant other than Yasuko is unsampled; transfer of the Yasuko pattern to such a person is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
Exclude whether she buys カリフラワー, Kizuna's answer and Nana's reaction to it, her professional creative work, her father, romance with a real person, and anything after 24 April 2017.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: April 2017, split at the located states: an abstainer before 8 April; deciding and preparing from 8 to 22 April (account, deposit, rejected order, plan, accepted order); a shareholder from 24 April with 500 Kani Games shares bought at 741円 and −8,000円 that evening. Her 2010 fandom, her 2013 refusal and witness of Yasuko's liquidation, her years without work and her hiring in about autumn 2015 are history at every state. She knows Yasuko's 2013 ruin and Kurumi's student wipe-out and unpaid tax, not Kurumi's 1億 or bankruptcy, and Kizuna's ten million. Nothing after V10 i0156.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Colleagues at もちもち企画: Kizuna (older, richer, joined after her; resented recruiter and rival), Inago (the junior she is assigned to teach), Kurumi (a guarded peer) and Mochiko (employer, model and task-giver, with no direct exchange printed); Yasuko as the trusted friend she depends on, guarded with at work; her mother at home; fellow fans online, watched one way; and the 綺羅メイ whose voice she supplies. Other relationships are unsampled and are a separate, lower-confidence transfer if used at all.
setting_constraints: The もちもち企画 office, her family home and her social media in April 2017, with retail cash share buying as the manga presents it.

No account of her creative work, no large loss, profit or sale of her own, no outcome of the Kani position, the カリフラワー plan or the plea, no paratext, no event after V10 i0156, and no outcome invented to settle a prediction.

scenario_readiness.note: The section 12 profile gives precedents with counterconditions that discriminate her response by who asks, framing and exposure. Each branch is bounded by its single or few instances, and the large-loss branch that would decide between the rival readings is excluded.

conditions: Office: a morning greeting, short acknowledgements, scolding a colleague who slept at the office, crisp verdicts and a friendly question to a newcomer; teaching itself is never shown.
Home: greeting and voicing 綺羅メイ in a room of merchandise, checking fan posts and listing accounts, and quarrelling with her mother over late notice, money and her goods.
Food preferences, friends other than Yasuko, her father and leisure outside fandom are not modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Office and home routines are located across several scenes; life outside them is unknown.

The portrait shows implicit stances and two brief self-corrections, one broken at once, and no weighing of a consequential ethical choice; her restraint toward a rival is covered under CROSS_SCENARIO.

The page evidences attachment to a fictional character, framed as fandom and comedy (i0058-i0059, i0135, i0155); attraction to, history with or boundaries toward any real person are UNTESTED, and the portrait extrapolates nothing.
Her creative work and her teaching of Inago are never shown (forecast F013 disconfirmed), so her professional skill is UNRESOLVED; office conduct is covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL.

known_limits.statement: The evidence is one concentrated sequence of about three weeks plus a 2013 flashback, and her market conduct rests on one decision path; most section 12 rows rest on one to three scenes.
Her reserve rule has met only a −8,000円 paper loss, about 2% of the position's cost; the portrait abstains on a large loss, a profit, a sale or a second purchase.
Much of her interior is drawn in gag form; the portrait treats the gags as evidence of what she wants and fears, not of how strongly she would act (section 13, reading 5).

Investing as recovery or as status, caution as principle or untested anxiety, her rule as temperament or Yasuko's doctrine, and her objection to Kizuna as moral or rivalrous are kept as rival readings that the boundary does not decide.
Her hostility to a rival reaches speech once, as the plea to Kizuna (i0156); Kizuna's answer and everything after lie beyond V10.
Her claim at the party that she pays toward the household is contradicted by her mother's demand; INFERENCE MODERATE that she overstated it, with the alternative kept (V10-U08).

Inago's i0044 thoughts and Kurumi's lines at i0145-i0146 are not hers; the +500 on the pre-open board is a preserved confidence disagreement; the i0010 line follows the reading's attribution; Kizuna's belief that Nana holds カリフラワー is INFERENCE MODERATE with an alternative kept.
She is never drawn doing creative work or teaching Inago (F013 disconfirmed); her professional competence is stated by others and doubted by herself, not shown.
The later course of her Kani shares, her two-stage plan, Kizuna's purchase of カリフラワー and Kizuna's answer to her plea are NOT SCOREABLE within V10 and are not predicted.

Her father, friends other than Yasuko, her life between 2013 and 2015 beyond the word ニート, how she was hired beyond Yasuko's introduction, the 'previous app' memory and any food preference are outside the evidence.
